definitions.explanation: A U-shaped curve in mathematics, defined as the set of points equidistant from a fixed point (focus) and a fixed line (directrix). Also used figuratively to describe arc-like trajectories.

notes:
Literally 'thrown-object line,' reflecting the parabolic path of a projectile. Commonly used both in mathematical contexts and figuratively in sports commentary to describe the arc of a ball.
